acip: YANG GANG ZAG 'GA' ZHIG LA DMIGS RTEN GZUGS CAN LAS GZUGS MED 'CHAR BDE BA 'BYUNG BAS, DE 'DRA DAG GIS NI, RJE'I LAM RIM CHUNG NGU'I DGONGS PA PAn CHEN CHOS RGYAN GYIS SROL PHYES PA
wylie: yang gang zag 'ga' zhig la dmigs rten gzugs can las gzugs med 'char bde ba 'byung bas, de 'dra dag gis ni, rje'i lam rim chung ngu'i dgongs pa paN chen chos rgyan gyis srol phyes pa
english: There are certain kinds of practitioners, on the other hand, who find it easier to choose a meditation object which is more ineffable—not so concrete. If you're someone like this, then you might prefer the system that His Holiness the First Panchen Lama—Lobsang Chukyi Gyeltsen—developed based on the train of thought found in Je Tsongkapa's briefer presentation on the steps of the path.
